_comment: Seed source for the crop-culture dataset (Irfan). Run `bunx tsx prisma/seed.ts` to load this into the database (crop_milestone_template / crop_task_template + crop.planDurationDays). At runtime the server reads the plans from the DATABASE, not this file. Keyed by lowercase crop name; matched to Crop rows case-insensitively. dayStart/dayEnd/suggestedDay are day offsets from the planting date. All dates are scaled proportionally if the farmer sets a custom expectedHarvestDate.
